crossRefs.note: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.
But commission Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall…
Moses called to Joshua, and said to him in the sight of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you shall go with…
Yahweh himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid.…

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: He laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as Yahweh spoke by Moses.
translations.bsb: and laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the LORD had instructed through Moses.
translations.kjv: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
translations.asv: and he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as Jehovah spake by Moses.
